dataset.note: solo running races only (scripts/race_data/dataset_stats.py): left out 216 bike / triathlon / relay / duo / pairs / team / walk / hike / stage / time-limited formats and PTL by name, 3 courses whose median finisher effort speed is a bike's or broken timing, 5 with fewer than 10 finishers, 2 without checkpoint distances. events = event series (an event's editions count once); finishers are those stored (UTMB Live up to 676 per race; of the 175 races stored, all finishers on 68, the fastest third whole then an even sample by rank on 60, an even sample of 150-450 by rank on the 47 collected first; LiveTrail up to 80, an even sample by rank)

fit.note: gradient curve + fatigue by hours + night in the app: fitted on UTMB Live races 40-180 km with a GPS track (train events: 71 races, 12464 finishers). Refit on 2026-10-04 on 121 running races with a track (43714 finishers; train events 74 races, 29596 finishers): no gain on the held-out events, not adopted

refit.selected_form: the current curve projected on the knot form (equal to the app's table from -15 to 25 %, not at -20..-16 % and 26..30 %), fatigue / night / terrain refitted (2-fold CV by event on train)

transjeju_2026.note: held-out race. mean_abs_gap_min: over its finishers, each planned at his own finish (362 of the 364 finishers stored: level groups of 3 runners or more). guard_16_21h: the finishers in 16-21 h. bib_*: bib 10 alone, planned at his own finish (the population model sets the shape; the level comes from the athlete's race model, so it gives no predicted_s)

livetrail.note: extra validation, never used to fit or select: LiveTrail running courses 40-180 km without GPS track (profile from section D+/D-), night not scored

validation.note: mean |gap| between the plan and the finishers' times at the checkpoints, each finisher planned at his own finish, on 6 events held out since the first fit (chiangmai, kullamannen, puertovallarta, transjeju, utmb, whistler). before = legacy = the app before the first fit; after = the app as it ships; races_improved = races where the app beats legacy. refit_* = the 2026-10-04 refit, not adopted (18.59 vs 18.61, better on 23/47 races, Transjeju guard worse)
